Design system · Round 1 of 3 · Foundations

Foundations, built on Board A

Brand direction, logo rules, colour with contrast checked in light and dark, type, spacing, photo crops, and a paste-ready tokens.css. This page itself is built only from those tokens, and follows your device’s light or dark setting. The side-by-side panels force each mode so you can compare.

1 · Brand direction

The Jet Lag Chronicles is a well-made travel magazine that happens to be written at a kitchen table by two people who really did live all this. Warm paper, one calm blue thread of route, and type that reads like a good book: the interface steps back so the photos and the stories can do the talking.

Warm

First-person, off-white paper, a human voice. Never a template.

Candid

Plain labels, honest disclosure, real numbers. Nothing dressed up.

Unhurried

Generous white space, one idea per screen, motion optional.

Five working principles

  1. Photos lead. Nothing competes with a cover photo: no overlays, badges or shadows on it.
  2. Blue means “you can click”. Link Blue marks links, the current page and focus. Route Blue only decorates.
  3. One route per section, at most. The three-segment dash divides major sections. It is never a bullet, border or loader.
  4. Type does the work. Hierarchy comes from size, weight and space, not from boxes and badges.
  5. Nothing depends on colour, motion or a mouse. Every state has a second signal (underline, label, shape).

What we kept from Board A, and what changed

Kept

  • All five Board A colours, same hex values.
  • Source Serif 4 for headlines, Source Sans 3 for text, and nothing else.
  • The three-segment route dash (1 : 7 : 18) as the one motif.
  • The quiet header and a photo-led cover with a title block that overlaps it.
  • A Country · City eyebrow above titles.

Enhanced (tell us if any is a step too far)

  • Eyebrows and the drop cap move from blue to ink. Blue now only means “clickable”.
  • Two extra text tones (muted, subtle) so captions and bylines are quiet but still AA.
  • A sunken and a tint surface for code, tables and the lesson box.
  • A full dark palette, and the logo recolours too.
  • An optional warm “clay” tone, used only to mark Reader Stories.
  • Country cards are portrait (4:5), like passport pages.

2 · Logo usage

Kept exactly as drawn. Only the two colours change, through --logo-ink and --logo-accent.

Full logo and ring mark, light and dark

Full logo · light
Full logo · dark
Ring mark · light
Ring mark · dark
Recolouring

Light: ink #2E3A4B, accent #0C90E9.
Dark: ink #E8EBF0, accent #2EA3F2 (6.6 : 1 on the dark page).
The accent is 3.25 : 1 on the light page. Logotypes are exempt from text contrast, and the name always also appears as real text (page title, footer, alt text).

Over a photo

One-colour white on the 64% scrim only (5.4 : 1 even over a pure white photo). Used for the social share image.

Clear space and minimum size

xxxx

x = the cap height of “THEJETLAG” (about 38% of the logo’s height). Keep at least x free on all four sides, and at least 2x between the logo and the nav on the same row.

Full logo: 120 px wide minimum on screen, 30 mm in print. Ring mark: 24 px in the interface, 16 px as the favicon only. Use the ring alone in the footer, favicon, avatar spots and small sizes. Use the full logo in the header and on share images.

What not to do

Don’t stretch or squash

Don’t recolour outside the tokens

Don’t add shadows or outlines

Don’t rotate or animate it

Don’t put it on a busy photo without a scrim

Don’t drop the ring from the full logo

3 · Colour tokens

Board A’s five colours, unchanged, plus the tones the components need. Each swatch pair is light then dark. Ratios below are computed by script from the hex values, not eyeballed.

How colour is used

  • Link Blue only on things you can click, plus the focus ring.
  • Route Blue is decoration only: the dash, the pin, list bullets. Never text, never the only signal.
  • Links are always underlined. The current nav page gets an underline and aria-current.
  • Labels such as “Affiliate” or “Reader Story” always carry words, not just a colour.

Surfaces, lightest to deepest

  • Page is the reading surface. Surface raises a card from it.
  • Sunken sits below: code, table headers, photo placeholders.
  • Tint is the one soft blue: the lesson-learned box.
  • Dark mode is a cool near-black, not pure black, so photos glow instead of glare.

4 · Typography

Two families, both self-hosted, five font files. Headlines in Source Serif 4, everything else in Source Sans 3, the logo’s own typeface.

Fonts and weights (only these)

  • Source Serif 4 SemiBold 600, roman: all headings
  • Source Serif 4 Regular 400 italic: lead and blockquote
  • Source Sans 3 Regular 400: body and UI
  • Source Sans 3 SemiBold 600: bold, nav, eyebrow, names
  • Source Sans 3 Regular 400 italic: emphasis, photo credit

Latin subset woff2: about 15 to 22 KB each, ~90 KB in total. Preload only Serif 600 and Sans 400. font-display: swap with size-adjusted fallbacks (next/font does this) so nothing jumps. No monospace: inline code reuses Sans 600.

Rules

  • Sizes are fluid between 320 and 1280 px with clamp(). Body never goes below 17 px, captions never below 14 px (the 13 px eyebrow is uppercase and AA).
  • Measure: body 66ch, lead 52ch, intros 46ch, titles 22ch.
  • Headlines use text-wrap: balance. Dates and costs use tabular figures.
  • Bold means 600, never 700. Don’t synthesise bold or italic.
  • Avoid glyphs outside the Latin subset (฿ → arrows). Write “THB”, and use inline SVG for arrows.

Story body content: light and dark

Links, lists, blockquote, table, inline code, rule and figures with caption and credit. Full-width photos break out of the text column to 896 px. The table scrolls inside its own box on narrow screens (it is focusable so keyboard users can scroll it). The CSS is further down.

Story body · light mode

The first week, we couldn’t sleep. The second week, we couldn’t sleep without the noise. By the end of the first month, the street vendor at the corner knew our order before we sat down. Here is what living here actually cost us, which neighbourhoods we’d pick again, and the one mistake we made with our first lease.

Three things to check before you sign

We learned these the slow way, so you don’t have to:

  • Ask which floor the nearest bar is on, and which way its speakers face.
  • Find out whether “quiet street” means quiet on a Tuesday or quiet at 2 a.m.
  • Pay the deposit by bank transfer, and keep every receipt, including the one for the TM.30 form.

“You’ll stop hearing it by week three,” our landlady told us. She was right, and also slightly lying.

Our landlady, Sukhumvit Soi 24

What a month cost us

One month in Bangkok, 2025 (our own spending, in Thai baht)
CategoryTHBWhat we’d change
Condo, 1 bedroom near the BTS22,000Ask for a 12-month lease and a lower rate.
Groceries and markets8,500Nothing. The market is the best part.
Eating out12,000Fewer rooftop dinners, more soi noodles.
Getting around1,800Learn the BTS map in week one.
Total44,300

A smaller thing worth knowing

  1. Book the first week somewhere flexible.
  2. Walk the street at night before you sign.
  3. Tell the landlady you’ll stay, then be surprised when you do.

story.css

/* story.css: styles for story body content. Tokens only. */
.story-grid {
  display: grid;
  justify-content: center;
  /* Text column is 66ch and centred in the page. Photos may use the wide tracks either side (up to --container-figure). */
  grid-template-columns:
    [wide-start] minmax(0, calc((var(--container-figure) - var(--measure-prose)) / 2))
    [text-start] min(var(--measure-prose), 100%) [text-end]
    minmax(0, calc((var(--container-figure) - var(--measure-prose)) / 2)) [wide-end];
  font: var(--weight-regular) var(--text-body) / var(--leading-body) var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--color-text);
}
.story-grid > * { grid-column: text-start / text-end; margin-block: 0; }
.story-grid > * + * { margin-block-start: var(--space-5); }
.story-grid > .wide { grid-column: wide-start / wide-end; }

.story-grid h2, .story-grid h3, .story-grid h4 {
  font-family: var(--font-serif); font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
  text-wrap: balance; scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--space-4));
}
.story-grid h2 { font-size: var(--text-h2); line-height: var(--leading-snug); letter-spacing: var(--tracking-heading); margin-block-start: var(--space-8); }
.story-grid h3 { font-size: var(--text-h3); line-height: var(--leading-snug); margin-block-start: var(--space-7); }
.story-grid h4 { font-size: var(--text-h4); line-height: var(--leading-heading); margin-block-start: var(--space-6); }
.story-grid h2 + *, .story-grid h3 + *, .story-grid h4 + * { margin-block-start: var(--space-3); }

.story-grid a {
  color: var(--color-link);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-thickness: var(--underline-thickness);
  text-underline-offset: var(--underline-offset);
}
.story-grid a:visited { color: var(--color-link-visited); }
.story-grid a:hover { color: var(--color-link-hover); text-decoration-thickness: var(--underline-thickness-hover); }

.story-grid ul, .story-grid ol { padding-inline-start: var(--space-5); }
.story-grid li + li { margin-block-start: var(--space-2); }
.story-grid ul li::marker { color: var(--color-route); }
.story-grid ol li::marker { color: var(--color-text-muted); font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); }

.story-grid blockquote {
  margin-inline: 0; padding-inline-start: var(--space-5);
  border-inline-start: var(--focus-width) solid var(--color-route);
  font: italic var(--weight-regular) var(--text-lead) / var(--leading-lead) var(--font-serif);
}
.story-grid blockquote footer {
  margin-block-start: var(--space-2);
  font: normal var(--weight-regular) var(--text-small) / var(--leading-ui) var(--font-sans);
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
}

.story-grid hr { border: 0; border-block-start: var(--border-hairline); margin-block: var(--space-7); }

.story-grid code {
  font: var(--weight-semibold) 0.9em var(--font-sans);
  letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  background: var(--color-surface-sunken); border: var(--border-hairline);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 0.1em 0.35em;
}

/* Table: scrolls inside its own wrapper, never the page */
.story-grid .table-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto; background: var(--color-surface);
  border: var(--border-hairline); border-radius: var(--radius-card);
}
.story-grid table {
  width: 100%; min-width: 30rem; border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: var(--text-small); line-height: var(--leading-ui); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.story-grid caption {
  caption-side: top; text-align: start; padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
  font-weight: var(--weight-semibold);
}
.story-grid th, .story-grid td { padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4); text-align: start; vertical-align: top; border-block-start: var(--border-hairline); }
.story-grid thead th { background: var(--color-surface-sunken); font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); border-block-end: var(--border-width-thick) solid var(--color-border-strong); }
.story-grid .num { text-align: end; white-space: nowrap; }
.story-grid tfoot th, .story-grid tfoot td { font-weight: var(--weight-semibold); border-block-start: var(--border-width-thick) solid var(--color-border-strong); }

/* Figure: photos keep their own orientation. The credit line is optional: render it only when the credit field is
   filled (required for guest and Reader Story photos). It sits under the caption, never on the photo. */
.story-grid figure { margin-inline: 0; }
.story-grid figure img {
  display: block; width: 100%; height: auto;
  background: var(--color-surface-sunken); border-radius: var(--radius-card);
}
.story-grid figure.portrait img { width: auto; max-width: 100%; max-height: 80svh; max-width: min(100%, 28rem); margin-inline: auto; }
.story-grid figcaption {
  margin-block-start: var(--space-2);
  font-size: var(--text-caption); line-height: var(--leading-ui); color: var(--color-text-muted);
}
.story-grid figcaption .credit { display: block; font-style: italic; color: var(--color-text-subtle); }

5 · Space, shape and photos

Spacing (4 px scale)

--space-14 px
--space-28 px
--space-312 px
--space-416 px
--space-524 px
--space-632 px
--space-748 px
--space-864 px
--space-996 px
--space-10128 px

Side gutter --gutter: 16 px at 320, 24 px from 768, 32 px from 1024. Content max 1152 px (--container-max), story photos 896 px, text 66ch.

Radius, border, shadow

radius-sm
2 px
radius-card
4 px
round
border-hairline
1 px
border-strong
1 px, 3 : 1
shadow-overlay

Cards are flat: a 1 px hairline, a 4 px corner, no shadow. The one shadow (--shadow-overlay) belongs to the mobile menu panel, so it reads as floating over the page.

Focus and targets

3 px focus ring, 3 px offset

Focus ring: --color-focus (≥ 3 : 1 on every surface, light and dark), shown on :focus-visible for every interactive element. The offset keeps it on the page colour even when the element sits on a photo. Targets: aim for --target-min 44 px, never below --target-floor 24 px. Inline links inside a sentence are exempt, but get an underline.

Breakpoints (mobile first, min-width only)

320
base
480
sm
768
md
1024
lg
1280
xl

The design must work at 320 px with no horizontal scroll. Test widths: 320, 390, 768, 1024, 1440. Media queries can’t read custom properties, so tokens.css lists them in a comment and as --bp-* for reference.

Photo crops (Cloudinary c_fill,g_auto, same photo each time)

Hero · 4:3 → 2:1 --ratio-hero
Story cover, country hero, section hero. 4:3 on phones, 2:1 from 768 px.
Hero wide · 2:1 --ratio-hero-wide
Desktop version of the hero. Most of our photos are phone shots, so 2:1 keeps more of the frame than 21:9 would.
Card · 4:3 --ratio-card
Standard story card.
Featured · 3:2 → 2:1 --ratio-featured
Featured card: 3:2 on phones, 2:1 from 1024 px.
Country card · 4:5 --ratio-country
Portrait tile. Name and story count go below, never on the photo.
Compact · 1:1 --ratio-compact
Small thumbnail beside a title, 88 px square.
Social share · 1200 × 630 --ratio-og
Cover plus title and logo, built later in round 3.
Author · 1:1, round --ratio-author
Always paired with a name. 72 px.
In-story figure · no crop
Photos inside the story keep their own shape. Landscape fills the figure width, portrait stays within 80% of the screen height. Always write alt text.

Captions and credits

  • Caption: 14 px Sans, muted ink, directly under the photo, never over it. One or two sentences, in our voice.
  • Credit: its own line, 14 px italic, subtle ink, formatted “Photo: Dunny”. The credit is an optional field: the line appears only when it is filled in. It is required for guest and reader photos. Older posts without per-photo credits show none.
  • Cover: the caption and credit sit below the cover photo, under the byline spacing, in the same style.
  • Placeholder while loading: --color-surface-sunken, and width and height always set so nothing shifts.
  • Alt text describes the photo. The caption tells the story. They are different sentences.

Editor notes for Cloudinary

  • Upload covers landscape, at least 2400 px wide, with the subject in the centre third.
  • Delivery widths: 320, 480, 640, 960, 1280, 1600, 2000, with f_auto,q_auto.
  • g_auto picks the crop. Override it with a custom focal point when a face or sign gets cut.
  • Cover photo is the LCP image: fetchpriority="high", never lazy. Everything else lazy.

6 · tokens.css

Light values on :root, dark values under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark). Also in the download bundle as tokens.css.

/* ==========================================================================
   The Jet Lag Chronicles: design tokens  (v1, round 1 draft)
   Light values on :root. Dark values under prefers-color-scheme (no toggle).
   Components may only use these tokens. Never hard-code a colour, size,
   space, radius, shadow or font.

   Breakpoints (mobile-first, min-width only; queries cannot read custom
   properties, so use the literal values). Components switch layout with
   @container ctx (min-width: ...) against the page shell, which equals the
   viewport on the real site and lets a demo show phone and desktop side by side:
     sm 30rem (480px) · md 48rem (768px) · lg 64rem (1024px) · xl 80rem (1280px)
   ========================================================================== */

:root {
  color-scheme: light dark;

  /* ---- Colour: light ---- */
  --color-page: #FBFAF7;
  --color-surface: #FFFFFF;
  --color-surface-sunken: #F3F0E8;
  --color-surface-tint: #EDF4F9;
  --color-border: #ECE6DA;
  --color-border-strong: #7D8794;
  --color-text: #2E3A4B;
  --color-text-muted: #566171;
  --color-text-subtle: #626C7A;
  --color-link: #0A64A4;
  --color-link-hover: #074E82;
  --color-link-visited: #6A3F93;
  --color-route: #0C90E9;
  --color-focus: #0A64A4;
  --color-guest: #96411F;
  --color-guest-surface: #F9EEE8;
  --color-selection: #CFE5F6;
  --color-on-scrim: #FFFFFF;
  --color-scrim: rgb(18 22 28 / 0.64);
  --logo-ink: #2E3A4B;
  --logo-accent: #0C90E9;

  /* ---- Type: families (self-hosted woff2; the only two families) ---- */
  --font-serif: "Source Serif 4", "Source Serif 4 Fallback", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  --font-sans: "Source Sans 3", "Source Sans 3 Fallback", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;

  /* ---- Type: sizes (fluid, 320px to 1280px) ---- */
  --text-h1: clamp(2rem, 1.55rem + 2.2vw, 3.25rem);          /* 32 to 52 */
  --text-h2: clamp(1.5rem, 1.3rem + 0.9vw, 2rem);            /* 24 to 32 */
  --text-h3: clamp(1.25rem, 1.15rem + 0.45vw, 1.5rem);       /* 20 to 24 */
  --text-h4: 1.125rem;                                       /* 18 */
  --text-lead: clamp(1.125rem, 1.05rem + 0.35vw, 1.3125rem); /* 18 to 21 */
  --text-body: clamp(1.0625rem, 1.03rem + 0.15vw, 1.125rem); /* 17 to 18 */
  --text-small: 0.9375rem;                                   /* 15 */
  --text-caption: 0.875rem;                                  /* 14 */
  --text-byline: 0.9375rem;                                  /* 15 */
  --text-breadcrumb: 0.875rem;                               /* 14 */
  --text-eyebrow: 0.8125rem;                                 /* 13, uppercase */
  --text-nav: 1rem;                                          /* 16 */
  --text-card-title: clamp(1.1875rem, 1.1rem + 0.4vw, 1.375rem); /* 19 to 22 */
  --text-card-title-compact: 1.0625rem;                      /* 17 */

  /* ---- Type: line heights ---- */
  --leading-tight: 1.08;   /* h1 */
  --leading-snug: 1.2;     /* h2, h3, card titles */
  --leading-heading: 1.3;  /* h4, compact titles */
  --leading-lead: 1.5;
  --leading-body: 1.7;
  --leading-ui: 1.45;      /* small, caption, byline, breadcrumb */

  /* ---- Type: weights, tracking ---- */
  --weight-regular: 400;
  --weight-semibold: 600;
  --tracking-display: -0.015em;
  --tracking-heading: -0.01em;
  --tracking-eyebrow: 0.14em;
  --underline-thickness: 0.075em;
  --underline-thickness-hover: 0.125em;
  --underline-offset: 0.2em;

  /* ---- Type: measure (max line length) ---- */
  --measure-prose: 66ch;   /* story body */
  --measure-lead: 52ch;    /* lead / summary */
  --measure-intro: 46ch;   /* section intros */
  --measure-title: 22ch;   /* h1 balance width */

  /* ---- Space (4px scale) ---- */
  --space-1: 0.25rem;  /*   4 */
  --space-2: 0.5rem;   /*   8 */
  --space-3: 0.75rem;  /*  12 */
  --space-4: 1rem;     /*  16 */
  --space-5: 1.5rem;   /*  24 */
  --space-6: 2rem;     /*  32 */
  --space-7: 3rem;     /*  48 */
  --space-8: 4rem;     /*  64 */
  --space-9: 6rem;     /*  96 */
  --space-10: 8rem;    /* 128 */

  /* ---- Layout ---- */
  --gutter-base: 1rem;         /* 16 at 320 */
  --gutter-md: 1.5rem;         /* 24 from md */
  --gutter-lg: 2rem;           /* 32 from lg */
  --gutter: var(--gutter-base);/* current side gutter; .shell widens it per container size */
  --container-max: 72rem;      /* 1152: header, grids, footer */
  --container-figure: 56rem;   /* 896: full-width photos in a story */
  --header-height: 4rem;       /* 64 */
  --header-height-md: 4.5rem;  /* 72 from md */
  --target-min: 2.75rem;       /* 44: aim for this */
  --target-floor: 1.5rem;      /* 24: WCAG 2.2 floor, never smaller */

  --container-text: 44rem;     /* 704: title block, intros, forms of text */
  --size-icon: 1.25rem;        /* 20: inline SVG icons */
  --size-icon-sm: 0.875rem;    /* 14: chevrons, external-link marks */
  --size-thumb: 5.5rem;        /* 88: compact card thumbnail */
  --size-avatar: 4.5rem;       /* 72: author photo */
  --size-logo-mobile: 8.75rem; /* 140: full logo, header, phone */
  --size-logo: 10.5rem;        /* 168: full logo, header, md and up */
  --size-ring-footer: 2.5rem;  /* 40: ring mark in the footer */

  /* ---- Radius ---- */
  --radius-sm: 0.125rem;       /* 2: route dash, label chips */
  --radius-card: 0.25rem;      /* 4: photos, cards, callout, table wrapper */
  --radius-round: 50%;         /* author photo */

  /* ---- Borders and focus ---- */
  --border-width: 1px;
  --border-width-thick: 2px;
  --border-hairline: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  --border-strong: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong);
  --focus-width: 3px;
  --focus-offset: 3px;

  /* ---- Shadow: almost none, on purpose ---- */
  --shadow-none: none;
  --shadow-overlay: 0 14px 28px -18px rgb(46 58 75 / 0.35), 0 1px 2px rgb(46 58 75 / 0.10);                      /* mobile menu panel only */

  /* ---- Photo aspect ratios (Cloudinary c_fill,g_auto) ---- */
  --ratio-hero: 4 / 3;              /* story cover, country hero, section hero. Becomes 2 / 1 from md */
  --ratio-hero-wide: 2 / 1;
  --ratio-card: 4 / 3;              /* standard card */
  --ratio-featured: 3 / 2;          /* featured card. Becomes 2 / 1 from md */
  --ratio-featured-wide: 2 / 1;
  --ratio-compact: 1 / 1;           /* compact card thumbnail */
  --ratio-country: 4 / 5;           /* country card */
  --ratio-author: 1 / 1;            /* author photo */
  --ratio-og: 1200 / 630;           /* social share image */

  /* ---- Route divider (the logo dash: segments 1 : 7 : 18) ---- */
  --route-thickness: 0.3125rem;     /* 5 */
  --route-gap: 0.5625rem;           /* 9 = 1.8 x thickness, as in the logo */
  --route-width: 14rem;             /* 224 */

  /* ---- Motion (optional, always cancelled by prefers-reduced-motion) ---- */
  --duration-fast: 120ms;
  --duration-base: 200ms;
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.6, 0.2, 1);

  /* ---- Stacking ---- */
  --z-header: 10;
  --z-menu: 20;
  --z-skip: 100;

  /* ---- Breakpoints (reference only; use the literal in @media) ---- */
  --bp-sm: 30rem;
  --bp-md: 48rem;
  --bp-lg: 64rem;
  --bp-xl: 80rem;
}

/* ---- Colour: dark (follows the device setting) ---- */
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --color-page: #12161C;
    --color-surface: #1A2028;
    --color-surface-sunken: #0E1217;
    --color-surface-tint: #15222F;
    --color-border: #2B333E;
    --color-border-strong: #6B7686;
    --color-text: #E8EBF0;
    --color-text-muted: #AEB8C5;
    --color-text-subtle: #9AA5B3;
    --color-link: #7CC2F5;
    --color-link-hover: #A8D8F8;
    --color-link-visited: #C4A6EB;
    --color-route: #2EA3F2;
    --color-focus: #7CC2F5;
    --color-guest: #F2A988;
    --color-guest-surface: #2B1F1A;
    --color-selection: #24496B;
    --color-on-scrim: #FFFFFF;
    --color-scrim: rgb(18 22 28 / 0.64);
    --logo-ink: #E8EBF0;
    --logo-accent: #2EA3F2;
    --shadow-overlay: 0 14px 28px -14px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.65), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.40);
  }
}

/* ---- Base rules every page inherits ---- */
::selection { background: var(--color-selection); color: var(--color-text); }

:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-width) solid var(--color-focus);
  outline-offset: var(--focus-offset);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }
}

Self-hosting the fonts (Next.js)

// web/src/app/fonts.ts
import localFont from 'next/font/local';

export const serif = localFont({
  src: [
    { path: './fonts/SourceSerif4-SemiBold.woff2', weight: '600', style: 'normal' },
    { path: './fonts/SourceSerif4-Italic.woff2',   weight: '400', style: 'italic' },
  ],
  variable: '--font-serif-face',
  display: 'swap',
  preload: true,
  adjustFontFallback: 'Times New Roman',
});

export const sans = localFont({
  src: [
    { path: './fonts/SourceSans3-Regular.woff2',  weight: '400', style: 'normal' },
    { path: './fonts/SourceSans3-SemiBold.woff2', weight: '600', style: 'normal' },
    { path: './fonts/SourceSans3-Italic.woff2',   weight: '400', style: 'italic' },
  ],
  variable: '--font-sans-face',
  display: 'swap',
  preload: true,
  adjustFontFallback: 'Arial',
});

Decisions (approved)

Your answers to the eight Round 1 questions. They are now part of the system.

  1. Blue means “clickable”. Eyebrow and drop cap are ink. Approved.
  2. Clay accent for Reader Stories only. Approved.
  3. Country cards are portrait 4:5. Approved.
  4. Covers are 4:3 on phone and 2:1 on desktop (--ratio-hero-wide: 2 / 1), because most photos are phone shots.
  5. Dark mode is cool near-black (#12161C). Approved.
  6. Photo credit only when one is filled in. Optional field; required for guest and reader photos.
  7. No monospace font. Inline code reuses Sans 600 in a sunken chip.
  8. Logo ink is #2E3A4B. Approved.

Foundations · Decisions applied. See Components and Pages for the rest.
